name: Straterius
source:
Straterius is a young monk-assassin from the Universal Church of Order, and man, does he ever take his job seriously! ...Actually, he takes everything seriously. I know him from Drama, where he's usually doing a bad job of lurking around being mysterious or acting like the one in charge. He seems to like Tough people.

[From in-game profile]
